title: Accept one quest through normal giver interaction

character.freshness: quest absent, no rewarded row, no unrelated objective state

preparation.purpose: Place a fresh character in the legitimate quest-giver context without granting the quest.
steps: Allocate a dedicated wayfarer/out-of-roster character and assert it is not grouped or roster-owned.
Seed only the allowed level/spec/gear fixture state; do not insert quest status or reward rows.
Use the named native route to stage near the exact giver entry and stable spawn.
Read questlog, acceptance, questobjective, snapshot, and giver position before operation.
Require the quest to be absent from the log and the character to be eligible for normal acceptance.

operation.purpose: Let the native quest AI acquire the quest through normal interaction, then observe it.
operation.priority_policy: the named quest directive may be highest priority only inside this fixture lease; priority is not proof
native_evidence_required: the character reaches the giver through native movement or is already at the seeded setup location; seeded location is not travel evidence
acceptance response reports a positive native reward_status or equivalent accepted state
questlog shows the exact quest id after the operation
questobjective reports the native objective vector, initially at zero unless the fixture explicitly tests interaction credit
for a gameobject objective, direct native use receipts and the exact objective delta are required

postconditions.predicate: the exact quest appears in the log and acceptance is positive without a database grant
the operation is attributed to the named giver context, not a random quest or grind fallback
only required for an interaction variant; exact native use receipt precedes the counter delta

current_bridge_can_prove: live objective and direct gameobject receipts when emitted
adapter_still_needed: provide an exact route when the named route is absent
support quest item use, escort, scripted event, or dungeon-group objectives
never_adapter_prove: quest completion without the native operation

cleanup: leave the quest in its native observed state or abandon through a separately authorized reset
do not mark it rewarded during cleanup
